{{Otheruses|Secretariat}}
The '''Chancellery Secretariat''' was the area located directly beneath the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]], in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It contained the [[Chancellor's working office/Legends|Chancellor's holding office]].

The Secretariat suite was a collection of chambers used by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] before and after sessions of Congress. The holding office contained the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]], which rose directly into the center of the Senate chamber for meetings. The Secretariat suite complemented the Chancellor's formal office in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]].
